GeneDef.label: darkeyes heritage
GeneDef.description: Dark-eyed and common-born. The darkeyes form the backbone of Vorin civilization - its soldiers, farmers, craftsmen, and merchants. What they lack in status, they make up for in resilience.

GeneDef.label: laborer's endurance
GeneDef.description: Generations of hard work have bred a body that endures. Less rest needed, more resistance to the elements, and a tolerance for pain that lighteyes rarely develop.

GeneDef.label: common resilience
GeneDef.description: The darkeyes endure what would break their betters. A lifetime of hardship has forged something durable.
